name: browser
description: Automated web browser for navigating pages, clicking, filling forms, and extracting content. Uses Playwright headless browser.

ref.description: Element ref from snapshot (e.g., 'e3') for click/fill/type actions

submit.description: Press Enter after typing (for type action)

full_page.description: Capture full page screenshot (not just viewport)

manual.overview: Interactive web browser for agentic automation. Navigate to pages, read AI snapshots of interactive elements (with semantic refs like e3), then click/fill/type using those refs. Essential for web automation, form filling, admin panels, and any task requiring web interaction.

examples.description: Navigate to a page and get an AI snapshot of interactive elements
Click the element with ref e3 from the last snapshot
Fill a text input identified by ref e1
Type into a search box and press Enter
Take a screenshot of the current page

tips: Always navigate first to get a snapshot of interactive elements on the page
Use refs from the snapshot (e.g., e3) to target elements -- never use CSS selectors
Take a new snapshot if a click causes the page to change significantly
Use 'type' instead of 'fill' for search boxes that need autocomplete/JS events
Use 'press' with key='Enter' to submit forms after filling fields
edge_cases: CAPTCHA pages will block automation -- report to user and ask for help
SPAs may need a snapshot refresh after navigation
Auth pages: always ask the user for credentials, never guess
Elements may shift after dynamic content loads -- re-snapshot if actions fail
